Class Material

java.lang.Object
edu.cssd2101.lab02.Material
Direct Known Subclasses:
AudioBook, EBook, Magazine, PrintedBook, VideoMaterial
public abstract sealed class Material extends Object permits PrintedBook, Magazine, AudioBook, VideoMaterial, EBook
Closed family of immutable materials with shared identity and a final price algorithm.

Identity is the catalogue ID across all subtypes. A sealed hierarchy makes every shipping case explicit. Adding a subtype requires extending its visitor.

    • priceCents

      public final long priceCents(int asOfYear, DiscountStrategy strategy)
      Applies intrinsic and external reductions multiplicatively, then rounds once HALF_EVEN.

      For 101 cents with 15 percent intrinsic and 10 percent extra, the unrounded amount is 77.265 cents, so the result is 77 cents. Input objects are never changed.

      Parameters:
      asOfYear - pricing context year, 1450..9999
      strategy - nonnull extra-discount policy
      Returns:
      nonnegative rounded cents, no greater than the base price
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if strategy is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if year or any discount is out of range
